'''Ludmila Bourchtein''' (also transliterated as Lioudmila Bourchtein) is a Soviet and Brazilian mathematician and textbook author, a [[professor emerita]] at the [[Federal University of Pelotas]] in Brazil.{{r|em}} Her research concerns [[mathematical analysis]] and [[conformal mapping]].{{r|sauer}}

==Education and career==
Bourchtein received a bachelor's degree in mathematics from the [[Far Eastern Federal University]] in [[Vladivostok]] in 1960,{{r|esc}} and continued to work at Far Eastern Federal University for 34 years as an assistant, associate, and full professor.{{r|em}} Meanwhile, she earned a doctorate through [[Saint Petersburg State University]] in 1968,{{r|esc}} with a dissertation on the solution of [[functional equation]]s for [[analytic function|complex analytic function]]s on the [[unit circle]].{{r|sauer}}

She joined the Federal University of Pelotas in Brazil in 1997,{{r|orcid}} as an associate professor and later as a full professor,{{r|em}} retired in 2010{{r|orcid}} and was named a professor emerita in 2019.{{r|em}} At the Federal University of Pelotas, one of her students was [[Adriana Neumann de Oliveira]], who credits Bourchtein as being her first female role model in mathematics.{{r|neumann}}

==Books==
With Andrei Bourchtein (her son), Ludmila Bourchtein is the coauthor of books, including:
*''CounterExamples: From Elementary Calculus to the Beginnings of Analysis'' (CRC Press, 2015){{r|cx}}
*''Counterexamples on Uniform Convergence: Sequences, Series, Functions, and Integrals'' (Wiley, 2017)
*''Complex Analysis'' (Springer, 2021){{r|ca}}
*''Theory of Infinite Sequences and Series'' (Springer, 2022){{r|tiss}}
*''Elementary Functions'' (Birkhäuser, 2023)
*''Ordinary Differential Equations: Exercises and Problems'' (College Publications, 2024)
